question: Where’s the closest university along the path connecting Muse Paintbar, Manchester, NH and Bunganut Town Park, Lyman, Me?
sql: WITH muse_paintbar_geom AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Muse Paintbar%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Manchester%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NH%' LIMIT 1 ), lyman_me_region_geom AS ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Lyman%' AND border_type = 'administrative' AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry::geography FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Maine%' AND border_type = 'state' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), bunganut_park_geom AS ( SELECT p.geometry FROM parks AS p, lyman_me_region_geom AS r WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Bunganut Town Park%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) LIMIT 1 ), path_geom AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine( ST_Centroid(m.geometry), ST_Centroid(b.geometry) )::geography AS path FROM muse_paintbar_geom AS m, bunganut_park_geom AS b ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, path_geom AS pg WHERE p.amenity = 'university' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, pg.path, 5000) -- Search within 5km of the path ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, pg.path) LIMIT 1;
